name: Komari Theme Commander
description: A cyberpunk command terminal theme for Komari Monitor. Features an interactive 3D globe, dual themes (Lumina / DeepSpace / Clean), terminal HUD-style node cards, and optional visual effects (scanlines, pulse, glow).
author: WayJam

data.name: Default View
data.help: The view mode shown on first visit

data.name: Globe Hub Node
data.help: Node name shown as the central hub on the globe. When set, animated arcs are drawn from every other online node to this hub. Use the node's real name — privacy-mode masking is applied after matching, so this field always references the original name. Leave empty to disable arcs.

data.name: Globe Mode
data.help: Dynamic: the globe auto-rotates. Static: the globe stays still until the viewer starts rotation manually.

data.name: Pause Globe for Reduced Motion
data.help: When enabled, the globe stops auto-rotating for viewers who prefer reduced motion (manual drag still works)

data.name: Globe Marker Style
data.help: Full: animated pulse markers with speed pills when a hub is set. Calm: flat markers — click and selection label kept, no pulse or speed pills. Lite (performance): WebGL dots only — select nodes from the sidebar or mobile fleet; significantly lower CPU while the globe rotates.

data.name: Enable Uptime View
data.help: Show the uptime leaderboard view option

data.name: Enable Billing Summary
data.help: Show the billing summary button in grid and table views (logged-in users only). Summarizes billing cycle cost, monthly estimate, and remaining value by group or region.

data.name: Default Theme
data.help: Default color theme for first-time visitors. 'auto' follows the user's system color scheme (light → lumina, dark → deepspace).

data.name: Custom Footer Text
data.help: Custom text displayed in the footer area

data.name: Enable Privacy Mode
data.help: When enabled, all node names are replaced with fake names to protect privacy
